summary: Well-designed test suite with comprehensive coverage of core matrix generation, CLI, and workflow integration. Excellent use of fixtures (baseConfig() helper) and TDD approach with clear cycle documentation. Includes valuable end-to-end testing through GitHub Actions via act harness. Minor gaps: type-coercion edge cases (e.g., string vs. number for max-parallel), complex exclude/include combinations, and null/undefined input handling not tested. Would reliably catch most regressions but some edge cases could slip through.
